_comment: VPS runtime settings. Secrets stay in .env.
_save_sessions_comment: false = do not keep sessions on VPS for the removed web gallery; unpack temporarily, send to Telegram, then delete. true = keep sessions_dir with photos/video/thumbs/files.json for web.
_media_transport_comment: yadisk = manifest inbox; notes = emergency legacy ZIP transport.
_yadisk_folder_comment: Yandex.Disk folder watched by the poller. Must match yadisk_folder on the photobooth side.
_yadisk_updates_folder_comment: Fixed private folder for full/small artifacts and status.json. Must match the photobooth config.
